component.name: Universal Calendar
component.summary: Fast, local-first calendar for CalDAV, Google and Microsoft

description.p: Universal Calendar shows your calendars from Nextcloud and other CalDAV servers, Google Calendar, Microsoft 365 and Outlook.com, and calendar subscriptions together in one fast desktop app. Everything is kept on your computer and synchronized in the background, so the calendar stays responsive and works offline.

ul.li: Month, week, day and agenda views, with search across all your events
Repeating events, including changes to "this and following" events
Changes made elsewhere are merged automatically where they do not overlap
Calendar groups, a command palette and full keyboard control
No account with us, no telemetry, no hosted backend

description.p: First release: CalDAV, Google and Microsoft accounts, ICS subscriptions, reminders, recurring-event editing, search and an agenda view.
